== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The issued June 10 erratum restricts the automatic stack to a Used Interrupt played from hand. The later printing removes ‘from hand’, makes stacking optional for the player’s opponent and adds the published Grabber icon absent from both earlier slips and underlying card. The period standalone ruling excludes Used or Lost and Used or Starting cards from the Used Interrupt category. Neither pile cost changes.
